articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Cybersecurity: The innovation and worries around agentic AI. AI is being deployed on both fronts of the cyber battlefield — from the cybersecurity firms offering protection to consumers and from hackers. TECHnalysis Research, LLC President Bob O'Donnell sits down with Yahoo Finance markets and data editor Jared Blikre on Market Catalysts to outline the innovation and worries tied to the deployment of agentic AI, especially when it is used in cybersecurity capacities. Watch Yahoo Finance's interview with CrowdStrike (CRWD) president Michael Sentonas on how the cybersecurity industry is using AI to combat hacks. Also read up on how North Korean hackers were responsible for over $2 billion in crypto losses in 2025. articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Cyber scams on the rise: How to avoid getting phished by hackers. Americans lost $12.5 billion in scams in 2025, according to a report from the US Federal Trade Commission (FTC), a whopping 25% increase from last year. Push Security CTO Mark Orlando discusses how to spot cyber scams and phishing messages, going into detail on a recent scandal where hackers used malicious Calendly links to trick people and gain their login info. Catch Mark Orlando explain where new online scams are becoming most prevalent — such as on networking sites like LinkedIn.
